verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's official desktop documentation has a 'Remote access' section with guides for both directions of the story: 'Share your desktop remotely' and 'Access a remote desktop'. The help site repeats the desktop-sharing guide. The evidence is only topic titles, so how the feature works is not shown. Missing for 10: details of supported protocols and setup, guide content beyond the titles, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
